card.fires_on: The piece just before the ending -emia in hyper- condition names, such as hyperammonemia, hypermagnesemia, hypercalcemia and hyperlipidemia. It is strongest in warnings and adverse reaction lists.

card.plain: It fires inside long names of high blood-level conditions, just before the ending that means 'in the blood'.
